Meta's Infrastructure Team Needs A Culture ResetMeta 基础设施团队需要一次文化重塑
SemiAnalysis · 2026-07-21
Meta's infrastructure org keeps making locally-defensible, globally-bad hardware choices — a \$2.5B acquisition nobody can explain, a GB200 rack 14% worse on TCO, and now a cut-in-half MI450 — because middle managers optimize for their own metrics and a six-month up-or-out review cycle punishes long-term thinking.
Meta 基础设施部门反复做出「局部说得通、整体很糟」的硬件选择— 一笔无人能解释的 25 亿美元收购、一款 TCO 高出 14% 的GB200 机柜，以及如今被砍掉一半的 MI450根源在于中层管理者只对自 己那一项指标负责，而半年一次的末位淘汰考核惩罚长期主义。
ENGLISH
1 Meta's six-month review cycle cuts the bottom 10–15% every round, producing an org that optimizes for short-term visible wins — internally called "window washing" — where few challenge leadership and bad decisions go uncorrected.
2 The >\$2.5B Rivos acquisition has largely unwound: Olympus, the chip meant to use Rivos' GPU IP, was cancelled; \~30% of incoming Rivos engineers were laid off; co-founder Mark Hayter has left; and SemiAnalysis expects CEO Puneet Kumar to exit once his shares vest.
3 Meta paid >\$2.5B largely to gain customerowned tooling (bypassing Broadcom) — a capability SemiAnalysis says could have been built from scratch for roughly \$100 million a year.
4 The Grand Teton H100 server added a switch tray with four Broadcom PCIe switches purely to fit eight more SSDs per box, for checkpointing storage that the model teams then barely used. The design was cancelled.
中 文
Meta 每半年一轮的绩效考核淘汰末位 10%–15%，由此养成了只追求短期可见成果的组织文化——内部称之为「window washing」（面子工程）——几乎无人质疑管理层，错误决策因而无人纠正。
超过 25 亿美元的 Rivos 收购基本已经瓦解：原本要采用 Rivos GPU IP 的芯片 Olympus 已被取消；并入的 Rivos 工程师约 30% 在近期裁员中被裁；联合创始人 Mark Hayter 已离职；SemiAnalysis 预计 CEO Puneet Kumar 也会在股票归属后退出。
Meta 花掉超过 25 亿美元，很大程度上是为了获得客户自有工具（COT）能力以绕开博通—而 SemiAnalysis 认为，这项能力 自建每年大约1 亿美元就能做到。
Grand Teton H100 服务器为了每台多塞进 8 块SSD，专门增加了一层带四颗博通 PCIe 交换芯片的交换托盘，用于训练检查点存储——而模型团队实际几乎没用上。该设计最终被取消。
KEY POINTS / 要点

5Meta's custom "Ariel" GB200 rack ran one B200 per Grace CPU instead of the standard two toserve RecSys,and used NVL36x2 on a bet that it would be more stable than NVL72's copperbackplane. Both calls were wrong - thebackplane matured, cross-rack cabling didn't,and 36x2 was dropped entirely for GB300.Arielcame in 14% worse on TCO,and becauseMeta's whole GB200 fleet was this SKU, its LLM teams ran on worse hardware than competitorsbought off the shelf. It cost Meta billions.Meta 定制的「Ariel」GB200机柜为服务推荐系统（RecSys），把标准的每颗Grace CPU配两颗 B200改成只配一颗，并押注NVL36x2会比走铜背板的NVL72更稳定。两个判断都错了背板逐渐成熟，跨机柜布线却没有，36x2在 GB300一代被彻底放弃。Ariel的 TCO 比标准配置高出14%，而由于Meta全部GB200 机队都是这一SKU，其LLM 团队只能用上比竞争对手现货采购更差的硬件。这让Meta损失了数十亿美元。
6The same mistake is repeating with AMD: Meta'scustom Ml450 halves the compute silicon and HBM stacks and downgrades to 8-Hi HBM4, on what would otherwise be the most advanced GPU on the market. TBD Lab has no interest in it, and SemiAnalysis publicly urges AMD to sellMeta the standard part instead.同样的错误正在AMD身上重演：Meta 定制版MI450 把计算芯粒与HBM堆栈砍掉一半，并把HBM4 降级为8层堆叠—而标准版本本会是市面上最先进的 GPU。TBD Lab 对这一配置毫无兴趣，SemiAnalysis 公开呼吁 AMD 改为向Meta供应标准版MI450。
7Meta's DSF networking fabric - built on Arista switches with Broadcom Jericho3-Al andRamon3 chips, single-vendor by construction -modeled out about 11% more expensive thanthe non-scheduled alternative once smarterNICs made fabric-level congestion controlunnecessary. Meta has largely pivoted to NSFfor Prometheus and Hyperion.Meta的DSF 网络 fabric 构建在Arista交换机与博通 Jericho3-Al、Ramon3 芯片之上，结构上就是单一供应商锁定；当NIC 变得足够智能、不再需要在 fabric 层做拥塞控制之后，其建模成本比非调度方案高出约11%。Meta 在Prometheus 与 Hyperion 上已基本转向 NSF。
8SemiAnalysis's fix: hardware decisions needclear ownership and real software/hardware co- design with MSL and TBD Lab - not theRecSys teams, which are "often still the tailleading the dog" - and custom SKUs shouldclear a high bar against standard configurations that benefit from industry-wide scale.SemiAnalysis 给出的解法：硬件决策需要明确的归属权，并与MSL和TBDLab 做真正的软硬件协同设计，而不是由推荐系统团队主导者「往往仍是尾巴摇狗、本末倒置」；定制SKU也应当在与享有全行业规模效应的标准配置对比时，跨过一道更高的门槛。
9 The stakes rise as Meta starts selling compute externally: outside customers won't pay for over-engineered designs, so if infrastructure is tobecome a product rather than a cost center, theculture that produced these missteps has tochange.随着Meta开始对外出售算力，风险随之上升：外部客户不会为过度设计的方案买单。若要让基础设施从成本中心变成一项产品，催生这些失误的文化就必须改变。
